use_oslogin.description: Enable or disable OS Login globally. When true, user and SSH key management is handled by Google's OS Login service.

ssh_public_key_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached SSH public keys. After this period, keys are refreshed from metadata.

ssh_public_key_sync.description: When enabled, SSH public keys are automatically synchronized from Google Compute Engine metadata.

sudoers_file.description: Path to the sudoers configuration file used to grant sudo access to OS Login users. Set to an empty string to disable sudo support.

authorized_keys_file.description: Path to the file where OS Login writes user-specific SSH public keys. Set to an empty string to disable authorized_keys file generation.

sshd_oslogin_enabled.description: When enabled, the SSH daemon integrates with OS Login to allow Google-managed SSH access.

items.description: SSH key type (algorithm) allowed for OS Login authentication. Typically includes modern key types.

sshd_key_types.description: List of allowed SSH key types. Only keys matching these types will be accepted from metadata.

cache_dir.description: Directory used for caching OS Login metadata and configuration data.

cache_use_cache.description: When enabled, cached metadata is used instead of fetching fresh data (subject to TTL).

cache_expiration.description: Time in seconds after which cached metadata is considered stale and refreshed.

cache_gpg_verify.description: When enabled, cached metadata files are verified using GPG signatures before use for security.

metadata_retries.description: Number of retry attempts when fetching metadata from the metadata server.

metadata_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each metadata request attempt.

items.description: Metadata server hostname to query for OS Login data.

metadata_servers.description: List of metadata server hostnames. Used for fallback in case the primary server is unreachable.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level. Valid values: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to an empty string to disable file logging and log to stdout/stderr only.
